items:
Winston at Rosemary - Whole Property | Inlet Beach, FL
32 Winston Lane, Inlet Beach, FL 32461

Dune Vacation Rentals presents: Welcome to Winston at Rosemary featuring a main house and a two story carriage house. This exceptional property includes a private pool, putting green, and sits on the edge of Rosemary Beach and Inlet Beach. Guests are steps from 30A's boutique shops, renowned restaurants, public beach accesses, and unforgettable coastal experiences. This property accommodates 16 guests with 6 bedrooms, 6.5 bathrooms, and built-in bunk beds. The heart of the home can be found outdoors with both front and backyard amenities including a private pool, putting green, fire pit, and ping pong table.

On the first floor, you will find an open concept living, dining, and full kitchen designed for entertaining and mealtime together. Generous seating and views of the pool create an inviting, comfortable atmosphere. The stylish dining table offers seating for 8 guests and countertop barstool seating for 3 guests. There is a half bathroom on this floor for convenience The outdoor space of the home offers plenty for the whole family to enjoy from a private pool, putting green, fire pit, ping pong table and comfortable seating for conversation.

The second level treats you to a guest bedroom with a king size bed, balcony access that overlooks the pool, and a private bathroom with a shower and tub combo. Next you will find two built-in hall bunk beds that can accommodate 4 guests. The last bedroom on this floor offers a king size bed. There is a hall bathroom with a walk-in shower that is shared with the king guest bedroom and bunk beds. There is a washer and dryer located on this floor as well.

The third floor of the home offers two king suites each complete with a full bathroom that includes a walk-in shower, soaking tub and plenty of space to relax and unwind from the day.

The two story carriage house is equipped with amenities tailored for a couple or small family. The top floor features one king bed, accommodates up to 2 guests comfortably, private bathroom with a walk-in shower, and has a well-appointed mini-kitchen for added convenience. The bottom floor of the carriage house serves as its own private retreat. Featuring a comfortable king bed, accommodates up to 2 guests comfortably, a convenient mini-kitchen, and bathroom with walk-in shower. The top and bottom floors of the carriage house both have separate, exterior entrances.

*While this property sits on the edge of Rosemary Beach and Inlet Beach and has prime views of the Rosemary Beach Tennis Courts, this home is not located within the Rosemary Beach Community limits. 32 N Winston Lane does not have access to the Rosemary Beach Community amenities or private beaches. The tennis courts are public access.

*Construction Notice: there are townhomes being constructed near by. Estimated that exterior work should be completed by late spring.

Reservation/Booking Policy
- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.
- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.
- Except for a $250 cancelation fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancelations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.
- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.
- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM
- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
